Amazon Rufus Optimizer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables simulation of Amazon Rufus conversations to assess product recommendation likelihood.
- Diagnoses and supplements missing intent tags across use, audience, scenario, and emotion dimensions.
- Rewrites traditional feature listings into Rufus-friendly conversational copy.
- Provides cross-category matching suggestions to expand product exposure scenarios.
- Delivers a Rufus visibility score and actionable optimization priorities.
